1753-3259-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
1753-3259-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

728-2178-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
728-2178-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

280-5686-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1308-2557-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Parallel Lives.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-2557-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1849-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-2946-4871-5075.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-4871-5075.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1376-5295.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-5295.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5477-6965-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-6965-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-6965-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1368-6321-6723-6968.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6723-6968.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3140-6085-7666.description:
Donate Altanak to an opponent.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

2034-4365-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4365-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

240-1753-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

11-4276-7089.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}.
11-4276-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Turnabout spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Turnabout spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Turnabout and returning the original Turnabout to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout from step 9, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Holding priority, repeat from step 2.
11-4276-7089.notes: You can tap creatures or artifacts instead if they can produce enough mana, or if you have excess mana.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
1270-2034-5320.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create three creature tokens due to Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
1270-2034-5320.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

2459-2511-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

560-2425-4550-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-4550-6797.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Repeat.

527-542-3499.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-3499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1636-5764-6625.description:
Activate Oggyar Battle-Seer by tapping it, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6260-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Caradora.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6260-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

1029-5028-5983.description:
Activate Snapping Voidcraw by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Snapping Voidcraw.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5983.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2-1283-1651-3263-5043.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue spell.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Faerie, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards, or you may untap any other artifact(s) you control.

1020-2866-4647-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-2866-4647-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Scrap Trawler and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers twice for itself dying, and once for the nontoken artifact.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger for the nontoken artifact, returning any applicable artifact to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the remaining Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.
